description: A man in a dark three-piece suit with slicked-back hair looks alarmed, eyes wide and mouth open. He holds a black candlestick-style telephone handset in one hand and presses a receiver to his ear with the other. He stands in a dark wooden booth with a glass-paned door. On the walls, framed seascapes show ocean liners with multiple funnels on rough grey-blue water. There is no legible text.
